sqlquery.from:
(SELECT l.id, l.firstname || ' ' || l.lastname as fullname, l.department as department , a.name AS companyname, atr.name AS accounttype, campaign.name as campaignname, l.primaryEmail as email, l.primaryPhone as phone, mu.firstname || ' ' || mu.lastname AS assignee, mm.subject as subject, mm.lastUpdateTime as sentdate, mt.openedCount as openedcount, (CASE WHEN lsmsstatus.code='ONBOUNCE' THEN true ELSE false END) AS bounced, (CASE WHEN lml.deleted=true THEN true ELSE false END) AS unsubscribed
FROM "$".leadsendmessagestatus lsms LEFT JOIN "$".crmContact l ON lsms.entity_id = l.id INNER JOIN "$".reference lsmsstatus ON lsms.statusid = lsmsstatus.id LEFT JOIN "$".crmAccount a ON l.crmAccount = a.id left join "$".crmaccount_types typeIDs on typeIDs.crmaccount_id = a.id LEFT JOIN "$".reference atr ON typeIDs.type_id= atr.id LEFT JOIN "$".myUser mu ON l.assignee = mu.id INNER JOIN "$".mailmessage mm ON lsms.messageid = mm.id LEFT JOIN "$".messagetrack mt ON mm.id=mt.messageid AND mt.entity_id = l.id LEFT JOIN "$".leadmaillist lml ON lml.entity_id = l.id INNER JOIN "$".campaign campaign ON mm.campaignid = campaign.id WHERE mm.status = ( select r.id from "$".reference r INNER JOIN "$".reference rp ON rp.id=r.parentid where rp.code='_MESSAGE_STATUSES' and r.code='SENT' )) t
